definitions.wins_csv: Correct selected OPUS candidate us < the fixed CSV baseline; no same-round FlyDSL dependence
definitions.candidate_identity: Exact six-field shape key plus complete current kernel name, with IDs checked for conflicts
definitions.single_pass: Latest single observation of that exact candidate; all profile candidates participate
definitions.repeat_median: Latest complete repeat batch; all expected rounds correct, automatic input rotation, median replaces all single observations
definitions.failed_repeat: A complete batch containing any failed round invalidates that exact candidate
definitions.pending_repeat: An incomplete batch cannot replace an existing complete median or single observation
definitions.require_repeat_winners: When enabled, official best and CSV scoring use only correct complete automatic-rotation repeat medians; discovery stays separate
definitions.discovery_best: Fastest correct candidate after completed-repeat replacement, including unconfirmed single-pass candidates; excluded from official scoring when repeats are required
definitions.full_top8_completed_shapes: Only shapes in --full-progress, kept separate from earlier directed coverage
definitions.historical_results: Excluded from current wins and candidate selection
